plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Snom SIP desk and DECT phones (private tree 1.3.6.1.2.1.7526, GET only). It reports uptime, CPU load average, free memory, SIP registration count, firmware, and interface traffic.
name: VoiceGateway

metrics.name: device_cpu_load1
metrics.description: 1-minute CPU load average of the Snom phone, parsed from the CPU load average string (1.3.6.1.2.1.7526.2.9, firmware V8.2.6 and later). This is a load average, not a utilization percentage.

metrics.name: device_cpu_load5
metrics.description: 5-minute CPU load average of the Snom phone, the second value of the CPU load average string (1.3.6.1.2.1.7526.2.9).

metrics.name: device_cpu_load15
metrics.description: 15-minute CPU load average of the Snom phone, the third value of the CPU load average string (1.3.6.1.2.1.7526.2.9).

metrics.name: device_memory_free
metrics.description: Free memory of the Snom phone (Memfree, 1.3.6.1.2.1.7526.2.7, Integer). The vendor does not document the unit, so the raw value is reported unchanged; use it for trends rather than absolute capacity.

metrics.name: sip_registration_count
metrics.description: Number of SIP registrations on the Snom phone (Registrations, 1.3.6.1.2.1.7526.2.5). A value of 0 means the phone has no working registration and cannot place or receive calls.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
